projects.name: The Biggest Punch
projects.description:
I worked primarily independently on an existing codebase, adapting and refactoring the code to align it with the game’s new design, thereby making a significant contribution to its transformation.

I was responsible for developing the majority of the project (over 80%), creating and integrating gameplay and UI, and ensuring consistency across the various components of the system.

I also implemented the localization system, enabling the game to be supported in multiple languages.

projects.name: Back To The Self
projects.description:
I developed the entire project independently, using the assets provided and handling all technical and integration aspects.

I managed the integration with an external hardware device via Bluetooth, which was responsible for emitting scents synchronised with the experience. To this end, I developed a custom tool in the Unity Editor to define and manage a timeline of olfactory events.

Given the highly immersive nature of the project, I optimised the experience to prevent freezes and performance drops, focusing in particular on scene transitions, where the user needed to enjoy a smooth, lag-free experience.

I also implemented an anonymous data collection system, linking the results of the questionnaires to Google Forms and Google Sheets for automated analysis.

projects.name: Moody Trial
projects.description:
The project was developed for the one-week Global Game Jam held in February 2026.

I was responsible for the full development of the player and combat system, managing input and feedback to ensure a smooth and responsive experience.

I implemented advanced combat mechanics, including knockback and player forward movement, both of which can be configured according to the type of attack.

I designed and developed the character’s abilities, using modular and reusable logic.

I also contributed to the development of the enemy AI, improving its behaviour and functionality.

projects.name: Save The Date
projects.description:
The project was developed in four days in the GMTK Game Jam held in July 2026.

I was responsible for implementing character movement, developing a slot-based system to manage destinations for all characters.

I also handled the game's UI, implementing all menus and panels, and worked on several managers responsible for the overall game flow.

projects.name: GoalMasters
projects.description:
Developed in collaboration with another programmer, building on an existing package which was extended and adapted to the project’s requirements.

I managed the user authentication system (sign in/sign up) and data persistence via Firestore, handling both reading and writing operations.

I was responsible for the complete development of the game menu UI, including the card collection with over 250 items, implementing an optimised infinite scroll to ensure scalability, smoothness and zero lag.

I developed the social features, including friend management and match invitations.

I also contributed to the gameplay, collaborating on the integration of mechanics to support singleplayer and multiplayer modes.

projects.name: Hex
projects.description:
Developed in collaboration with another programmer, with primary responsibility for the gameplay logic.

I implemented the card-based move system, using Scriptable Objects to make it easily configurable and extensible.

I developed a system of in-game events that are triggered at specific moments, capable of dynamically interacting with the game board.

I designed the architecture by separating the game logic from the graphical representation, to ensure greater scalability and support a future multiplayer extension.

I also implemented the enemy AI, based on a move evaluation system using scores configurable via the Inspector, capable of analysing possible actions and selecting the most advantageous one for that turn.
